Sadalmelik is a prominent star located in the constellation Aquarius, known for its brightness and significance within the celestial sphere. Its Bayer designation, Alpha Aquarii, designates it as one of the brightest members of this water-themed constellation. Positioned at approximately 22.1 hours right ascension and about -0.32 degrees declination, Sadalmelik is easily identifiable in the night sky for observers in suitable viewing locations.

This star is classified as a supergiant, a stellar type characterized by its immense size and luminosity. Supergiants like Sadalmelik have evolved beyond the main sequence phase of stellar evolution and are often nearing the end of their life cycles. The specific physical details, such as its exact distance from Earth or its brightness magnitude, are subject to ongoing astronomical observation and analysis.
